final:
parity(x: u8) -> bool =
  post out == (bits.count_ones(x) % 2 == 1)
  ex parity(0 as u8) == False
  ex parity(1 as u8) == True
  ex parity(3 as u8) == False
  bits.count_ones(x) % 2 == 1

test_parity() =
  assert parity(0 as u8) == False
  assert parity(1 as u8) == True
  assert parity(2 as u8) == True
  assert parity(3 as u8) == False
  assert parity(7 as u8) == True
  assert parity(255 as u8) == False
